rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a job or regular work.

example.english: I recently found a new occupation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 wan2 dou2 fan6 san1 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for someone’s profession or when describing an occupation formally, such as on a form.

example.english: When filling out the form, write your occupation clearly.
example.traditional: 填表嗰陣要寫清楚自己嘅職業。
example.jyutping: tin4 biu2 go2 zan6 jiu3 se2 cing1 co2 zi6 gei2 ge3 zik1 jip6

rows.note: Use this for the military control of a country or region, especially in compounds such as 占領時期.

example.english: During the Japanese military occupation of Hong Kong, many people's lives were hard.
example.traditional: 日軍占領香港嗰段時間，好多人生活都好艱苦。
example.jyutping: jat6 gwan1 zim3 ling5 hoeng1 gong2 go2 dyun6 si4 gaan3 hou2 do1 jan4 sang1 wut6 dou1 hou2 gaan1 fu2
